title: Tuition Invoice
description: A month's tuition invoice for one student: class breakdown, balance, session details, payment instructions with the VietQR code. Replaces src/components/invoice/InvoicePrintView.tsx (single print) and the PDFs inside the TuitionBulkDownload.tsx ZIP.

standard.description: Statement-like: every block in the original order, totals set under the class breakdown, payment details after the session list.

summary-first.description: The balance panel and the payment details sit side by side at the top of page 1, before the class and session tables. Same text; the tagged reading order stays the original order.
